Literal collapse-inverse wording was too strong: for the identity map of an interval, the first collapse of the square must fix its two vertical sides. The corrected statement retains the expansion factorization, zero torsion and tau(f)=p_*tau(i_X), and proves p is homotopic rel Y to the reversed collapse composite r via rH. Step 1.2 now uses the ball-pair homeomorphism instead of a projection as its witness; the component paragraph groups source components by their target component.
